route: no screen change: one refusal sentence added to the existing hidden preview
data: Synthetic only: sample book pages printed by real Chromium, drawn digits as written answers, photos made by a perspective map, blur and JPEG.

evidence.what: SCAN_MATRIX_OUT=<file> npx vitest run src/lib/scan-binding-chromium.test.ts -t "every scale". 24 real pages (U4, U16, U26), page fill 50% to 95%, upright, rotated 7 degrees and tilted, calibrated on the normalized upload bytes among all 24 pages. nearTwinsAlsoStoppedBySheet: pairs that only the QR code stopped, asked again with the sheet check alone, as if that page's code were pasted on the sheet.

anotherPageEvidence over the same 24 pages and 16 conditions: the highest score of a right page among the others (RIGHT, 0.253) and the lowest scores of a photo read as its near twin (WRONG, from 0.511). The cutoff ANOTHER_PAGE_MARGIN is 0.38. The pageNumber field is unused.

The two #456 cases (QR code pasted on a near twin; page 8 over page 5 with its footer folded behind) with the sheet check switched off, as on main: both calibrate (pageFit 0.985 for the pasted code, 0.975 for the overlap).

limits: No real camera photo, curled saddle-stitched page or real handwriting. Candidates are the child's printed pages of the same page type.
